boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-cost ways to share art, library resources, recurring programs, and waterfront park time on campus and around Beverly.

cards.title: Browse a Grillo Gallery Exhibition
cards.subtitle: Free public art inside Endicott’s Manninen Center
cards.notes: Choose a current group or student exhibition, invite a friend, and contact the gallery before arriving to arrange your visit.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission gallery outing centered on juried, student, and visiting-artist exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott states that the Carol Grillo Gallery is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; Endicott’s current visitor information says gallery exhibits require an appointment and close during holidays, breaks, and school closures.

cards.title: Compare Art at Desnoyers Overlook
cards.subtitle: A free exhibition stop featuring varied regional voices
cards.notes: Meet at the Manninen Center, select one work each to discuss, and arrange an appointment with gallery staff beforehand.
cards.short_summary: A conversation-friendly gallery visit featuring student, local, and visiting artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott states that Desnoyers Overlook Gallery is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; Endicott’s current visitor information says gallery exhibits require an appointment and close during holidays, breaks, and school closures.

cards.title: See a Visiting-Artist Show at Heftler
cards.subtitle: Free artwork connected to Endicott courses and student experience
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition, arrange the required appointment, then gather a small group to discuss how the work relates to class.
cards.short_summary: A free visiting-artist exhibition designed to connect art with students’ studies.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott states that the Heftler Visiting Artist Gallery is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Heftler Visiting Artist Gallery | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; Endicott’s current visitor information says gallery exhibits require an appointment and close during holidays, breaks, and school closures.

cards.title: Tour the Spencer Presentation Gallery
cards.subtitle: One stop on Endicott’s free public gallery circuit
cards.notes: Reserve a gallery appointment, bring a classmate, and use the exhibition labels to trade observations without buying a ticket.
cards.short_summary: A compact, admission-free art discussion inside the Manninen Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott’s visitor information identifies Spencer Presentation Gallery among gallery exhibits that are free and open to the public by appointment.
cards.source_title: Center for the Arts Visitor Information | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public by appointment only; galleries close on holidays, during winter and spring break, and during school closures.

cards.title: Walk Through a Library Art Exhibit
cards.subtitle: Free community exhibitions at the Main Library or Farms Branch
cards.notes: Check which exhibit room is active, bring a friend during regular hours, and build a short walking conversation around the displayed work.
cards.short_summary: A changing community-art outing with no admission or purchase attached.
cards.evidence_claim: Beverly Public Library states that its exhibits are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free during regular library hours when community meetings or library programs are not using the exhibit space.

cards.title: Hold a Free Digital Co-Work Session
cards.subtitle: Public computers and Wi-Fi at both Beverly library locations
cards.notes: Bring a project and headphones, meet at either branch, and work side by side using the free Wi-Fi or available public computers.
cards.short_summary: A purchase-free place for friends to study, plan, or work online together.
cards.evidence_claim: Beverly Public Library states that free Wi-Fi and computers for patron use are available at its Main Library and Farms Branch.
cards.source_title: Computers, WiFi & Document Services - Beverly Public Library
cards.access_notes: Wi-Fi and computer use are free at both branches; printing, copying, and faxing have separate charges, so skip those services for a zero-dollar visit.

cards.title: Join the Monday Mornings Series
cards.subtitle: A recurring free adult program at Beverly’s Main Library
cards.notes: Watch for the fall schedule, choose a topic with a friend, and arrive before the 9:30 a.m. start so you can sit together.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal weekly program that turns a weekday morning into a shared learning outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Beverly Public Library describes Monday Mornings as a free weekly adult program offered during spring and fall.
cards.access_notes: Free adult series at the Main Library, generally 9:30–10:30 a.m. in spring and fall; the spring 2026 series has ended, so verify the posted fall schedule.

cards.entity_name: Beverly Public Library Library of Things
cards.title: Try the Library of Things Together
cards.subtitle: Free nontraditional borrowing with a library card
cards.notes: Browse the current catalog with a cardholder, select an available item, and plan a shared activity around its stated borrowing rules.
cards.short_summary: A free way to build a hang around equipment or another nontraditional library item.
cards.evidence_claim: Beverly Public Library states that its Library of Things is free and requires a library card.
cards.source_title: Library of Things - Beverly Public Library
cards.access_notes: Free with a library card; availability, loan periods, card eligibility, and in-library-only restrictions vary by item.

cards.title: Take a Waterfront Break at Independence Park
cards.subtitle: A free-entry Beverly park overlooking the harbor
cards.notes: Walk or bike over with friends, use the shoreline as a conversation backdrop, and carry out everything you bring with you.
cards.short_summary: A simple, ticket-free waterfront meetup in a named Beverly park.
cards.evidence_claim: Beverly City Council records characterize Independence Park as a smaller free-entry park.
cards.source_title: Beverly City Council Meeting Minutes – June 22, 2021
cards.access_notes: The city identifies the park as free-entry; parking conditions and any temporary site restrictions should be checked before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Dane Street Beach at Lyons Park
cards.title: Meet by the Water at Dane Street Beach
cards.subtitle: A free-entry beach park in Beverly
cards.notes: Bring a blanket, meet on the public beach during daylight, and choose a spot that does not block paths or active recreation areas.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission shoreline hang at Beverly’s Dane Street Beach and Lyons Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Beverly City Council records characterize Dane Street Beach as a smaller free-entry park.
cards.source_title: Beverly City Council Meeting Minutes – June 22, 2021
cards.access_notes: The city identifies the park as free-entry; verify current beach conditions, posted rules, and parking restrictions before setting out.

warnings: Endicott’s gallery exhibits currently require appointments; visitors should confirm availability before traveling.
Monday Mornings is seasonal, and its spring 2026 series has ended; the library says the series returns in fall.
The municipal free-entry evidence for Independence Park and Dane Street Beach comes from a 2021 Beverly City Council record; current posted parking and site rules should still be checked.
